race.comment: INVINCIBLE LOVER (5) sets the benchmark off a first-up third at Cranbourne in BM66 grade, where she was beaten just over a length after settling back and finishing strongly. Her 1000m profile is the strongest in the field, with one win and four places from five starts at the distance, and she has placed in all six career runs. Finds an ideal race, rates clear. MISS COTOLETTA (1) resumes off two trials, has a solid 1000m record and can run a forward race. ILOVEDIAMONDS (3) rises in grade but is hard to knock off back-to-back wins. Could take the next step. CATCH IT KISS IT (4) resumes after showing promise in a short maiden campaign, winning here on debut. Keep safe.
